id: 24_Replace the Display Screen for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder
title: 激光焊接机更换显示屏
source_doc: course/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/24_Replace the Display Screen for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder.md
author_source: project/Cleanroom & Equipment Safety/24_Replace the Display Screen for the xTool MetalFab Laser Welder/src.py

points.K7: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线
points.K8: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏
points.K9: 新屏入支架，排线对缺口
points.S2: 机器顶上不放水杯杂物
points.S4: 贴膜不能遮住警示标识

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光焊接机旁，指着机器顶上的显示屏
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a blank gray wheeled handheld laser welding machine and points at the touch screen on its top.
shots.narration: 这一课讲激光焊接机怎样更换显示屏。
overlay: 激光焊接机更换显示屏

shots.scene: 撬棒、水杯打叉、触屏、警示标识、焊枪五个图标
shots.prompt_en: Five icons in a row: a pry tool with an outward arrow, a crossed-out cup, a touch screen with a fingertip, a warning sign, and a welding gun pointing away from a person. No people.
shots.narration: 换屏步骤之外，还有几个小习惯。

shots.scene: 阿杰把水杯放在焊接机顶上，用螺丝刀尖点屏幕
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts his water cup on top of the laser welding machine and taps the touch screen with the tip of a screwdriver.
shots.narration: 屏幕失灵了，阿杰用螺丝刀尖去点它。

shots.scene: 屏幕上出现一道划痕，水杯晃了一下
shots.prompt_en: A scratch appears on the blank touch screen and the water cup on top of the machine wobbles.
shots.narration: 屏幕被划花，水杯也差点洒进散热口。

shots.scene: 小研拿开水杯，叫来老李
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student moves the cup away and waves the facility engineer over.
shots.narration: 小研拿开水杯，请老李来换屏。

shots.section_title: 机器顶上不放水杯杂物
shots.scene: 欣欣指着机器顶面的散热格栅
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at the vent grille on the top surface of the machine.
shots.narration: 机器顶上有散热口，不是置物台。
overlay: 机器顶上不放水杯杂物

shots.section_title: 机器顶上不放水杯杂物
shots.scene: 水杯、螺丝、饮料放在机器顶上的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a cup, loose screws and a drink bottle on top of a machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 液体洒进去会短路，零件掉进去会卡住。

shots.section_title: 机器顶上不放水杯杂物
shots.scene: 小研把水杯放到实验室门口的饮水区
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carries the cup to a separate drinking area near the lab door.
shots.narration: 水杯放到指定区域，不带到设备旁。

shots.scene: 台面上两把十字螺丝刀、黑色撬棒、镊子
shots.prompt_en: Top view of a wooden bench with two cross-head screwdrivers, a black plastic pry tool and tweezers. No people.
shots.narration: 备好两把十字螺丝刀、撬棒和镊子，

shots.scene: 一块新显示屏和一张黑框空白贴膜
shots.prompt_en: A new display panel with a green circuit board back and a blank black-framed screen protector sticker on the bench. No people.
shots.narration: 还有新显示屏和新保护膜。

shots.scene: 老李关机，拔下电源插头和其他线缆
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer switches off the machine and unplugs the power cord and other cables.
shots.narration: 关机，拔掉全部线缆。

shots.scene: 老李把四个脚轮锁扣踩下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses down the brake levers of all four caster wheels.
shots.narration: 锁好底座四个脚轮。

shots.scene: 老李用撬棒撬起保护膜的一个角
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts one corner of the screen protector with the plastic pry tool.
shots.narration: 用撬棒把保护膜四个角撬起来，

shots.scene: 老李用手把保护膜整张揭下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the whole screen protector off by hand.
shots.narration: 再整张揭下来。

shots.scene: 撬棒用力方向朝外、远离另一只手，打勾
shots.prompt_en: Icon: a pry tool pushing away from the body with an arrow, the other hand placed behind it, green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 撬的时候，用力方向朝外。

shots.scene: 撬棒朝着按住屏幕的手用力，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon: a pry tool pushing toward the other hand holding the screen, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 工具一打滑，朝着手就会划伤。

shots.scene: 露出的金属支架边缘有一些残胶
shots.prompt_en: Close view of the metal screen bracket with small spots of leftover glue along its edge. No people.
shots.narration: 支架上有残胶的，清理干净。

shots.scene: 老李用撬棒向外轻刮残胶
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer gently scrapes the glue residue off with the pry tool, pushing away from himself.
shots.narration: 刮胶同样向外用力，慢慢来。

shots.scene: 老李用小号十字螺丝刀拆下支架螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer removes the bracket screws with a small cross-head screwdriver and puts them in a tray.
shots.narration: 用小号十字螺丝刀，拆下八颗螺丝。

shots.section_title: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线
shots.scene: 老李双手抬起屏幕组件
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer lifts the screen assembly up from the top of the machine with both hands.
shots.narration: 抬起屏幕，背面连着一根排线。
overlay: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线

shots.section_title: 抬起屏幕，拔下背面排线
shots.scene: 老李用镊子剥掉排线上的胶，再拔下排线
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels glue off the ribbon cable with tweezers, then unplugs the cable.
shots.narration: 排线上有胶，先用镊子剥掉再拔。

shots.section_title: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏
shots.scene: 屏幕放在台面上，老李拆背面螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The screen assembly lies face down on the bench; the facility engineer removes the screws on the back.
shots.narration: 放到台面上，用大号螺丝刀再拆八颗。
overlay: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏

shots.section_title: 再拆八颗螺丝，取下旧屏
shots.scene: 旧屏和金属支架分开放在台面上
shots.prompt_en: The old screen and the empty metal bracket lie separately on the bench with the screws beside them. No people.
shots.narration: 旧屏从支架上取下来。

shots.section_title: 新屏入支架，排线对缺口
shots.scene: 新屏放进支架，黄色软排线对准支架缺口
shots.prompt_en: The new screen is placed into the bracket; a yellow flexible cable lines up with a notch in the bracket. No people.
shots.narration: 新屏放进支架，黄色软排线对准缺口。
overlay: 新屏入支架，排线对缺口

shots.scene: 老李拧紧屏幕背面的螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer tightens the screws on the back of the new screen.
shots.narration: 拧紧八颗螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李把排线插回屏幕背面
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer plugs the ribbon cable back into the back of the new screen above the machine.
shots.narration: 回到机器上，接回排线。

shots.scene: 屏幕放回机顶，老李拧紧支架螺丝
shots.prompt_en: The screen assembly sits back on the machine top; the facility engineer tightens the bracket screws.
shots.narration: 放回屏幕，拧紧其余八颗螺丝。

shots.scene: 老李揭开新贴膜背纸，对准屏幕四角
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer peels the backing off a new blank screen protector and lines up its corners with the screen.
shots.narration: 贴新保护膜，先对齐四个角，

shots.scene: 老李用手掌从中间向四周抹平
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer smooths the protector from the center outward with his palm.
shots.narration: 再从中间往外抹平，不留气泡。

shots.section_title: 贴膜不能遮住警示标识
shots.scene: 机身上的激光警告标志清楚可见，旁边打勾
shots.prompt_en: A laser warning sign on the machine body is fully visible next to the new screen, with a green check mark. No people.
shots.narration: 贴膜和贴纸，不能盖住机身的警示标识。
overlay: 贴膜不能遮住警示标识

shots.section_title: 贴膜不能遮住警示标识
shots.scene: 一张贴纸盖住半个警告标志，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a sticker half covering a warning sign on a machine, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 标识被挡住，别人就看不到危险提示。

shots.section_title: 贴膜不能遮住警示标识
shots.scene: 欣欣指着封面有激光标志的空白小册子
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at a blank booklet with a laser warning pictogram on the cover.
shots.narration: 激光产品的标记要求，以现行国家标准为准。

shots.scene: 手指轻点新屏幕，屏幕亮起空白界面
shots.prompt_en: A fingertip lightly taps the new touch screen, which lights up with a blank interface. No people.
shots.narration: 触摸屏用手指轻点就好。

shots.scene: 螺丝刀尖、笔尖戳屏幕的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a screwdriver tip and a pen tip poking a touch screen, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不用螺丝刀、笔尖这些尖东西戳。

shots.scene: 屏幕点不动，阿杰停手去报修
shots.prompt_en: The touch screen does not respond; the young male student stops and fills in a blank repair card.
shots.narration: 点不动就停用报修，不要硬按。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在焊接工位旁，手持焊枪模型指向墙面
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a welding bench holding a welding gun model pointed down at the work table, away from people.
shots.narration: 换好屏试机时，焊枪口始终朝向工件。

shots.scene: 焊枪口朝向人的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: Icon of a handheld welding gun nozzle pointed at a person, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 不管有没有出光，枪口都不对着人。

shots.scene: 老李戴防护眼镜试焊，小研和阿杰在围挡外
shots.prompt_en: Wearing laser safety goggles, the facility engineer test-welds at the bench while the two students stay behind an opaque curtain.
shots.narration: 试机前清场，旁人退到围挡外。

shots.scene: 老李放下焊枪，挂回挂架
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer finishes and hangs the welding gun back on its holder on the machine.
shots.narration: 不用时焊枪挂好，不随手放。

shots.scene: 欣欣身后浮现几个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside the machine with icons floating behind: a pry tool arrow, a crossed-out cup, a fingertip, a warning sign and a welding gun.
shots.narration: 撬向外，顶上不放杯，轻点屏，标识露，枪口不对人。

shots.scene: 阿杰把水杯放在饮水区，向镜头点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student places his cup in the drinking area and nods at the camera.
shots.narration: 阿杰改掉了两个坏习惯。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye at the camera in the workshop.
shots.narration: 小习惯，保安全。下次见！
